critical_code_review_comments: LoadingOverlay is cleanly factored with per-flow presets (FLOWS_DE/FLOWS_EN) — good reuse across 4 pages.
DailyCheckinPage correctly uses onTranscription prop matching VoiceRecorder interface — prop-name mismatch bug fixed.
ChallengersPage ANSWER_OPTIONS_DE constant fully removed; placeholder 'Deine Antwort — frei formulieren oder einsprechen...' guides free-form input.

Dashboard xp_info lives on /api/dashboard-v4 (frontend calls this first, falls back to /dashboard). Legacy /api/dashboard does NOT return xp_info — fine for now since UI uses v4, but consider consolidating to avoid confusion.
Email service gracefully handles missing RESEND_API_KEY: cron returns per-window status with skip count; test reminder returns 503; status endpoint returns enabled:false. Good fail-safe design.
services_email.py uses BackgroundTasks for registration confirmation — non-blocking. Good pattern.

Challenger flow uses phone-call UI (Wlad incoming call with Annehmen/Ablehnen buttons) before chat — not mentioned in review request but present and working. LoadingOverlay likely triggers after Annehmen is clicked (could not observe due to network timing, but overlay component is wired with flow='challenger').
